LIFE SKILLS ACTIVITY 3 · CLASS 32 · AGES 4–5

Get Ready

Dressing all by yourself, clothes to the right body area and a morning in the right order.

THE ACTIVITY — WRITE AND DRAW RIGHT ON THE SHEET

Your sheet is ready.

Pick a color or the eraser, then circle, match, trace and draw straight on the sheet with your finger, a stylus or the mouse. Press Save my work when you are proud — that is what marks this activity cleared for your child.

← Ask for HelpPrevious activityPack Up →Next activity
HOW TO DO IT

Five little steps.

  1. 1

    Circle

    Find the child who is dressing all by himself — circle him.

  2. 2

    Sequence

    Think about your morning: put the getting-ready pictures in order, 1, 2, 3.

  3. 3

    Match

    Draw a line from each piece of clothing to the body part where it goes.

  4. 4

    Trace

    Trace the words GET READY with steady, careful lines.

  5. 5

    Draw

    Look at the three habits and draw a star beside the helpful one.

Ask a grown-up to read the steps aloud the first time. After that, you know just what to do.

YOUR PENCIL CASE

Pick your tools.

Pencil, nine crayons, an eraser, undo, redo and clear — the tools appear right here and work on the sheet. Save keeps your finished work as a picture.

MY PROGRESS

Save it to keep it.

This activity is cleared for you the moment you save your finished sheet. Nothing counts until then — opening the page is just opening the door.

Cleared! Your saved work for this sheet is in your downloads, and the ribbon is on in Class 32.

PREFER PAPER?

Print the twin.

The same sheet lives in the worksheet library with its download and print buttons: /worksheets/life-skills/get-ready/. Crayons beat styluses sometimes.

FOR GROWN-UPS

What this sheet practises.

Lay out tomorrow’s clothes together at bedtime and let your child dress themselves in the morning — buttons and zips are exactly the fine-motor work this sheet practises.

  • Dressing independently
  • Clothes to body areas
  • Morning sequencing
  • Word tracing
  • Spotting helpful habits

This activity belongs to Class 32 — Life Skills & Good Habits on the Learning Path. Progress is saved on this device for the child chosen in My Classroom — and only a real save of finished work marks it cleared, never just opening the page.
